fields.name: Addressable Fire Alarm System
fields.short_description: Intelligent addressable fire alarm panel installation, testing and maintenance for hospitals, offices and industrial facilities.
fields.description:
HY-FY Technology installs, tests and maintains addressable fire alarm
systems for hospitals, schools, offices, industries and commercial
buildings across Chennai.

Our addressable panels pinpoint the exact location of a fire alarm
trigger, reducing response time and false-alarm confusion compared to
conventional zone-based systems. We handle everything from initial
site survey and panel selection to cabling, detector placement,
commissioning, and ongoing Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).

Whether you're upgrading an existing conventional system or installing
fire detection for the first time, our certified technicians ensure
your system meets safety compliance requirements.
fields.meta_title: `Addressable Fire Alarm System Installation
fields.meta_description: Professional installation, testing and AMC for addressable fire alarm systems in Chennai. Trusted panels, certified technicians.
